Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Name: Full Moon
Cardtype: Master
Clan: Gangrel/Gangrel antitribu
Cost: 1 pool
Unique master. Requires a Gangrel or Gangrel antitribu of capacity 5 or more.
Put this card into play with one counter on it. During your untap phase, remove a counter if it has one, otherwise you may pay 1 pool to put a counter on it. While there is a counter on it, Gangrel and Gangrel antitribu gain one level of Protean [pro].

Basically, it can be the full moon one turn out of 2, provided you pay a pool. It benefits all the table (well, all the Gang/!Gang). These clans tend to have interesting vampires that do not have pro at all (or the inferior level).

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Agreed. For a card that works only 1 turn out of 2, cost 1 pool on each turn it serves, it shouldn't be burnable. I didn't want to make it a path because paths tend to be master intensive. And thematically, burning a Full Moon doesn't make much sense (but the card could be named elsewise).
Giving werewolves +1 strength or a press seems pretty strong and would be too hard to balance. Better make another card for werewolves.
